message:
Thanks, Clancy and Michelle!

And, well, Clancy: no chopping block, babe -- there'll just come a day when you tell me: "Go, [Grasshopper](http://www.kungfu-guide.com/guide.html). I have sheltered you from the world for too long. You must find your own way, now. " And I'll be all like, "But, Master, why?" And you'll be like, "When you cease to strive to  understand, Grasshopper, then you will know without understanding." And I'll be like, "But, Master, why?" And you'll be like, "Oh, get off my blogroll, you dipshit." And I'll be like, "But, Master, why?" ;-)

I dunno. Twenty just feels right, I guess.
